items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: This boy named Mason, I believe his name, very good. He played solos... So I worked with them for, oh I guess, about a year or more to stay on them.

ctx.x: Is there any fellows from New Orleans in the band that you can remember? In the Rabbit's Foot...

I can't remember any fellows from New Orleans... Let's see... No... I can't remember any of the boys from New Orleans... There was... No... No... No I can't... But there was a very good trumpet player there... But there was a very good trumpet player there... But I was always... Tip된 stuff... Tip된 stuff... Tip된 stuff... Tip된 stuff... Tip된 stuff... Tip된 stuff... Tip된 stuff... Tip된 stuff... Tip된 stuff...

at working with the good trumpet players. This boy named Mason, I believe his name, very good. He played solos. They do a lot of that, they give concerts. He's very good. So I worked with them for, oh I guess, about a year or more to stay on them. And I went back to Louisville. And I stayed around Louisville there for a good while until, oh, until 20. Well, I came back and worked around with the dance bands around there. And then I left, left Louisville
